integrity: Complete analytic proof and standalone finite verifier; finite checks do not prove the all-population statement.
scientific_limitations: Dichotomous approvals, candidate degrees at most Hare quota, standard EJR and utilitarian welfare. The sharpness family establishes a uniform degree cutoff but does not classify instances above it. No independent validation; unindexed equivalent sufficient conditions remain a publication-priority risk.
title: The sharp Hare-support threshold for welfare-optimal extended justified representation
